tools.name: BrowseInsightAssets
tools.title: Browse Insight Assets
tools.description: List the files and directories from a relative filePath input from within the insight folder

filePath.title: filePath
filePath.description: The relative file path to list contents from.

tools.name: CopyInsightAsset
tools.title: Copy Insight Asset
tools.description: Copy (clone) a file or directory in the insight assets folder to a new path

filePath.title: filePath
filePath.description: The source file or directory to copy. This relative path should assume the prefix of the insight folder.

newValue.title: newValue
newValue.description: The destination path for the copy. This cannot be an existing file or directory unless override is true and has the same character restrictions you would expect on a typical file system.

override.title: override
override.description: Whether to delete an existing file or directory at the destination before copying. Defaults to false.

tools.name: DeleteInsightAssets
tools.title: Delete Insight Assets
tools.description: Delete a single or multiple files in the insight folder

filePath.title: filePath
filePath.description: Names of the file(s) to delete. This relative path should assume the insight folder. If no value is passed, all files in the insight folder will be deleted.

tools.name: DownloadInsightAsset
tools.title: Download Insight Asset
tools.description: Download a file or directory from within the insight folder

filePath.title: filePath
filePath.description: The relative file path to a file or directory within the insight folder

tools.name: GetInsightAssetsBase64
tools.title: Get Insight Assets Base64
tools.description: Retrieve the contents of a file (image, pdf, etc.) as base64 encoded string in the insight

filePath.title: filePath
filePath.description: Names of the file to get the contents as a base64 encoded string

tools.name: GetInsightAssets
tools.title: Get Insight Assets
tools.description: Retrieve the contents of a file in the insight

filePath.title: filePath
filePath.description: Names of the file to get the contents

tools.name: NewInsightAssetsDirectory
tools.title: New Insight Assets Directory
tools.description: Create a new empty directory in the insight folder

filePath.title: filePath
filePath.description: Names of the file to create.

tools.name: NewInsightAssetsFile
tools.title: New Insight Assets File
tools.description: Create a new empty file in the insight folder

filePath.title: filePath
filePath.description: Names of the file to create.

tools.name: RenameInsightAsset
tools.title: Rename Insight Asset
tools.description: Rename a file or directory in the insight assets folder

filePath.title: filePath
filePath.description: Names of the file(s) to save. This relative path should assume the prefix of the insight folder.

newValue.title: newValue
newValue.description: The new name for the file or directory. This cannot be a name for an existing file or directory and has the same character restrictions you would expect on a typical file system.

tools.name: SaveInsightAssetsBase64
tools.title: Save Insight Assets Base64
tools.description: Save a single or multiple files in the insight assets folder. Content for each file is provided as base64 utf-8 encoded input.

filePath.title: filePath
filePath.description: Names of the file(s) to save

content.title: content
content.description: Contents of the file(s) to save. Content is base64 utf-8 string.

decode.title: decode
decode.description: Boolean to decode the base64 utf-8 content string before writing to the file. Default is true

tools.name: SaveInsightAssets
tools.title: Save Insight Assets
tools.description: Saves one or more files to the insight assets folder and commits them to the insight's git repository.

filePath.title: filePath
filePath.description: Names of the file(s) to save

content.title: content
content.description: Contents of the file(s) to save.

tools.name: SearchInsightAssets
tools.title: Search Insight Assets
tools.description: Recursively search files and directories within the insight's assets folder, filtered by search term and optional searching flags.

filePath.title: filePath
filePath.description: The relative file path to search files from. This relative path should assume the file path till insight's folder and relative path should start onwards

search.title: search
search.description: The search term used to filter file and directory names

options.title: options
options.description: A list of zero or more search flags to modify matching behavior. Valid values are 'case' for case-sensitive matching, 'word' for whole-word matching, and 'regex' to treat the search term as a Java regular expression. If omitted, the search is case-insensitive.

tools.name: UnzipInsightAssetFile
tools.title: Unzip Insight Asset File
tools.description: Unzips a zip file located in the current insight folder

filePath.title: filePath
filePath.description: The relative file path of the zip file within the current insight folder to extract
